customers.name: customers
customers.summary: Master directory of all registered buyer accounts, their geographical locations, and account statuses.
customers.purpose: Stores customer profiles and contact details to support order placement, identity tracking, and geographical market analysis.
customers.dependencies_thoughts: Primary source of customer entity. Referenced by `orders.customer_id` via foreign key.

columns.description: Unique integer identifier for each customer.
Full name of the customer.
Customer email address used for notifications and unique login identification.
Primary city where the customer is based.
Customer country of residence (e.g., 'USA', 'UK', 'Spain', 'Germany').
Timestamp when the customer profile was initially registered.
Account status: 'active', 'inactive', or 'suspended'.

products.name: products
products.summary: Catalog of all goods available in the store, their categories, inventory quantities, and base pricing.
products.purpose: Maintains merchandise information, pricing, stock levels, and product category grouping to manage commerce operations.
products.dependencies_thoughts: Referenced by `order_items.product_id` to determine line-item pricing and item names.

columns.description: Unique integer identifier for the product item.
Descriptive title or commercial name of the product.
Merchandise classification category, such as 'Electronics', 'Apparel', or 'Home & Kitchen'.
Standard retail unit selling price in dollars.
Current number of units remaining in warehouse inventory.
Boolean flag (1 for active, 0 for discontinued/inactive).

orders.name: orders
orders.summary: Transaction headers capturing buyer purchases, order lifecycle statuses, total billings, and destination.
orders.purpose: Records customer purchasing transactions, tracking shipment fulfillment states and aggregated order values.
orders.dependencies_thoughts: Parent table for `order_items` (via `order_id`) and `payments` (via `order_id`). Foreign key `customer_id` joins to `customers.id`.

columns.description: Unique identifier for the order purchase transaction.
Foreign key pointing to `customers.id` representing the buyer.
Date and time when the customer placed the order.
Fulfillment status: 'pending', 'completed', 'cancelled', or 'refunded'.
Gross financial total for the entire order in USD.
Destination city for physical shipment delivery.
Destination country for delivery.

order_items.name: order_items
order_items.summary: Detailed line items for each order specifying products purchased, quantities, unit prices, and discounts.
order_items.purpose: Deconstructs an order into individual product lines to track product-level sales volumes and discounts.

columns.description: Unique primary key for the specific order line item.
Foreign key pointing to `orders.id`.
Foreign key pointing to `products.id`.
Number of units purchased for this product line.
Charged price per individual unit at purchase time.
Monetary discount deduction applied to the line item.

payments.name: payments
payments.summary: Financial payment settlement records for orders, including payment gateways, amounts, and statuses.
payments.purpose: Logs transactional payment reconciliation, settlement outcomes, and payment method attribution.

columns.description: Unique integer identifier for the payment event.
Foreign key pointing to the corresponding `orders.id`.
Timestamp when the payment attempt was processed.
Channel used: 'credit_card', 'paypal', 'bank_transfer', or 'crypto'.
Financial dollar amount settled in this payment transaction.
